name: Yunoki-Kami's Gift To A Kitsune Girl
source:
Aiko is a fox who disguises herself as a human! Will Hong continue his journey or gave up? Make sure to found out on Yunoki-Kami's Gift To A Kitsune Girl!

[From [url=https://holyshit.itch.io/yunoki-kamis-gift-to-a-kitsune-girl]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
爱子是一只伪装成人类的狐狸！洪会继续旅程，还是选择放弃？去《结城神给狐狸女孩的礼物》中寻找答案吧！

[来源：[url=https://holyshit.itch.io/yunoki-kamis-gift-to-a-kitsune-girl]Itch.io[/url]]
